selection_rationale: CAND-001 directly targets the highest-priority gap (empirical evaluation of LLM generation guarded by deterministic NetOps verifiers), is experimentally falsifiable with paired design, feasible within provided compute/model budgets, and yields operationally meaningful outcomes (unsafe-accepted reduction) for the CNSM Agentic-AI track.
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic verifier coverage for semantic and vendor-specific failure modes (completeness).
Sandbox/verifier mismatch: verifier-passed configs may still behave unsafely in richer or vendor-specific environments.
LLM repair loop may produce superficial fixes that 'game' the verifier rather than correct semantic faults.
Task corpus construction and sampling bias could skew measured effect sizes.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Use multiple verifiers and vendor-model variants (e.g., Batfish plus at least one vendor simulator/emulator) to broaden verification coverage.
Define, document, and publish a representative task taxonomy and sampling procedure; include public templates, seeds, and selection criteria for the 300 tasks.
Include a stratified, human-curated ground-truth safety-label set (held-out) to validate verifier decisions and estimate verifier false-accept/false-reject rates.
Add adversarial/verifier-gaming checks: construct adversarial counterexamples and include metrics for repair-quality beyond raw verifier pass (semantic checks and plausibility heuristics).
Predefine and freeze prompt templates, random seeds, retry policy, and exact verifier configurations; produce a machine-readable preregistration manifest prior to any model calls.
Specify paired-analysis statistical plan (McNemar, exact CIs, Benjamini–Hochberg for secondary tests) and minimum detectable effect size with power calculation to justify task/sample size.
